sections.text: Introduction

This document outlines the 
 testing procedure P1, which must be performed on an annually bases as 
 indicated by Y1 in the title block.

The 
 GCAG14 relay may be used for any type of high impedance circulating current 
 protection. It is used for protecting generator windings and transformer 
 earthed star side.

The first draft initiated by eng. Samy Abdou Sayed, tested by eng. 
 Hany Bassuny, accepted by eng. Mahmoud Badawy general director, revised by 
 WDEPCo. quality control general director eng. 
 Gamal Abdel Wahab, approved by Dr. Sarwat Sabry, and certified by WDEPCo. quality 
 control head sector eng: Mohmed Hassan Gomaa
Safety Precautions

A work permit 
 must be issued and the qualified maintenance staff should carry the suitable 
 safety category.

Safety fence 
 (rope) with caution marks surrounding the work area is required.

Safety and 
 Healthy equipment must be used (safety 
 Helmet, safety shoes, ...etc).
The transformer must be isolated.

Make 
 sure that the CT's secondary circuits are shorted at the incoming blocks 
 before isolating the relay current circuit for test.

sections.text: Preparation

The 
 test set should be capable of providing voltage up to 120% of the relay 
 setting.

Isolate 
 all the trip signals.

If 
 the relay is wired through an MMLG test block it is recommended that all 
 secondary injection tests should be carried out using this test block.

Ensure 
 that the main system current transformers are shorted before isolating the 
 relay from the current transformers.

When 
 type MMLG test block facilities are installed, it is important that the 
 sockets in the type MMLB01test plug, which correspond the current transformer 
 secondary windings are shorted together.
